items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: he was playing with Donald Marsh, Rufus Smith, and Gus Fontaine and Mercedes

ctx.x: He would be on bass. Before he had his false teeth or even or not? Did he do anything at all when he?

No, he didn't. No, that was after he had got his false teeth. I forgot about that too. Yeah, he was playing with Donald Marsh, Rufus Smith, and Gus Fontaine and Mercedes, I forgot what Harold's last name is. And the boy who played trumpet was named Harold, I forgot his last name, but his wife was playing piano.
Did he borrow that horn or wasn't his?
